AUTOPASS-ENABLED.title: Auto-end turn when no actions remain
AUTOPASS-ENABLED.hover.desc: Automatically end your turn when you have no playable card and no usable potion. Press F8 anytime (including mid-fight) to toggle this on or off, with an on-screen indicator.
AUTOPASS-AUTO_PICK_IDENTICAL.title: Auto-pick identical selection cards
AUTOPASS-AUTO_PICK_IDENTICAL.hover.desc: When a fixed-count card selection (e.g. Survivor discarding one of several unenchanted Strikes) offers only functionally identical cards, resolve it automatically and skip the selection screen. Optional selections like Well-Laid Plans always show their screen. Single-player only.
AUTOPASS-POTION_MODE.title: Potions block auto-pass
AUTOPASS-POTION_MODE.hover.desc: When a usable potion should prevent auto-passing. Always: any usable potion blocks. Elites & bosses only: hallway fights auto-pass while you hoard potions, but elite/boss fights (and the Lantern Key guardian) never end your turn while you hold one. Never: potions are ignored. With the latter two, drink potions before playing your last card, or use F8.
